disclaimer: Animal Vision modes are human-viewable simulations of selected perceptual differences. They are not exact recreations of an animal’s subjective experience. Your display remains a human RGB monitor.
privacyNote: Processed locally. Your photographs are never uploaded.
displayLimitation: Non-human sensory experiences cannot be literally displayed on a human RGB monitor. Simulations show selected differences that research supports approximating from RGB.
